task: Welcome to another life changing episode of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First step, make an attempt to venture west. Once you get through with that, recover the key from the floor of the garage. After taking the key, assure that the gateway is unlocked. Having unlocked the gateway, open the gateway. After that, travel west. With that over with, make an attempt to move north. And then, pick up the latchkey from the floor of the workshop. That's it!
